blocking.what: The blocked-request count can clear while Activity is not visible.
blocking.why: ShieldPage keeps the Network panel mounted. IntersectionObserver tests its position, so the hidden panel can remain intersecting. NetworkTab then marks each new event as seen while another tab is open.
